newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Miniature says ok with EPS estimate. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Chicago Miniature says ok with EPS estimate. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]

text.p: Chicago Miniature Lamp Inc said Tuesday at its annual meeting that it expects to report record sales and earnings, and said it is "comfortable" with analysts earnings estimates of $1.10 per share for 1997. (Corrects from $0.10 per share)
The company reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.26. Its earnings per share for the year ended Dec. 1, 1996 was $0.83.
The company said 1997 earnings estimates exclude any potential foreign currency gains, and growth is expected to come internally.

The company said integration of the recently acquired Valmont Electronic is nearly complete, and with the regorganization of its European operations on schedule to be completed by the end of the second quarter, it is expecting improved margins.
The company's annual meeting was held in Marlborough.
